messages.Einzelne Begegnungen aus der öffentliche: Individual encounters from the public player history, including opponents and set scores. These are not official DBV match IDs.
messages.Eine belastbare Verlaufsgrafik benötigt: A reliable progress chart requires several dated ranking snapshots. Placings from different age groups are not mixed.
messages.Deine aktuelle Begegnung, nächste Spiele: Your current match, upcoming matches and results, with documented source information.

messages.Deine eigenen Turnierlinks, unabhängig v: Your own tournament links, independently of the current live status.
messages.Alle bisher nachgewiesenen Veröffentlich: All verified publications mentioning the selected player by name, from club websites and regional associations to other media. Only the headline, a short description and the original link are stored.
messages.Berichte werden geladen, sobald du diese: Reports load when you open this section.

Share the public setup link. It opens a welcome page where someone can create a player profile or enter a DBV player ID or official profile link.
messages.Die Einladung ist frei teilbar und enthä: The invitation link can be shared publicly and contains no private data. It does not transfer existing profiles or favorites and is not an invitation to a cloud account.
messages.Wir bewerten die Datenquellen nach Verlä: We rate sources by reliability: official DBV data, association records, club reports and third-party services. The current DBV Excel ranking provides only total points; the five individual tournament scores are checked separately.
messages.Eigene Spieler, gefolgte Freunde und ges: Your players, followed friends and saved tournaments are stored only on this device. A backup file lets you keep them or transfer them to another device.
messages.Die Sicherung enthält Spielernamen und F: The backup contains player names and favorites. It is not sent to us. Restoring it replaces data on this device only after you confirm.
messages.Deine eigenen Profile, gefolgten Spieler: Your profiles, followed players and tournament favorites stay in this device's browser. There is no automatic family cloud synchronization. Local backup files are not uploaded to us.
messages.Daneben stellt Schmetterlinge öffentlich: Schmetterlinge also provides publicly readable DBV player details, clubs, tournament placements and individual source records from a shared Supabase database. This may include data about minors.
messages.Bei der Anzeige von Spielerergebnissen w: When player results are displayed, the public DBV player IDs shown are transmitted to the shared Supabase database for read-only queries.
messages.Erst beim Öffnen der Historie: Only when you open the history
messages.eines eigenen oder gefolgten DBV-Profils: of your own or a followed DBV profile may an additional server-side source check be requested. Public Badhub match cards may then be retrieved automatically and stored in a shared cache. Following a player, setting up a profile or opening Home does not trigger a new history request. Previously requested server-side updates may still continue.
messages.Historienquellen werden nach einer ausdr: Following an explicit request, history sources are checked for updates for up to 14 more days. Automated checks then stop until the history is opened again. These 14 days are
messages.für gemeinsam belegte Spielergebnisse. N: for jointly documented match results. Unverified or missing results are not presented as official DBV matches.
messages.Öffentlich auffindbare Sportdaten sind n: Publicly discoverable sports data is not automatically cleared for every type of reuse. Sources, actual retention periods, legal basis and correction/deletion procedures are still being reviewed. A complete privacy notice, including a responsible contact, is not yet available. Personal-data requests should not be submitted through public GitHub issues.
